ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the given food chain, if grasses dried up in summer, what would likely happen to grasshoppers?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a food chain from left to right: sun (sun) points through an arrow to grass (grass), grass points to grasshopper (grasshopper/locust), grasshopper points to shrew (shrew), and shrew points to owl (owl). Reasoning: In a food chain, arrows indicate the flow of energy or food sources, and grass is the food source of the herbivorous insect grasshopper. If the grass dries up in summer, the food that grasshopper can eat will decrease, so their number will very likely decrease.
